group.name: Talent Matching
group.description: Talent Matching is a startup focused on developing and placing young professionals in the marketplace, raising self-awareness both in the industry and in every individual so that we can assert everybody is making the right choice, committing to a job and to self at the same time. We are ourselves committed to true matching, solidly bridging the gap between well prepared young talents and a right selection of companies which will be able to support their development and ensure high performance.
